items.t: Diesel EGR cooler cracks and leaks coolant into the engine
items.job: Replace EGR cooler with revised part
items.note: May be free under Ford program 21M03 if your van is covered.

items.t: Diesel fuel injection pump can fail and stall the van (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel injection pump (and injectors if contaminated)
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: NOx sensor or SCR catalyst failure on the diesel
items.job: Replace NOx sensor
items.note: May be covered by Ford's warranty extension. An SCR catalyst costs much more.

items.t: Overheating from coolant deposits clogging the radiator
items.job: Flush cooling system, replace radiator, refill with Motorcraft Yellow coolant

items.t: Weak heat or uneven heat side to side
items.job: Flush or replace heater core
items.note: A flush is quick; replacing the heater core takes much longer.

items.t: Coolant leak at the thermostat housing or block heater
items.job: Replace thermostat housing and O-rings

items.t: Driveshaft coupling can crack (recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft coupling
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Trailer tow module can take on water and short out (recall)
items.job: Relocate and seal or replace trailer tow module
items.note: Free under the recall. The exact years covered vary by build date; check your VIN.

items.t: Rear brake hose can leak fluid (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair rear brake hoses
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Sliding door missing reinforcement (recall)
items.job: Reinforce sliding door
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear axle shaft can break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear axle shafts
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: A/C does not cool well
items.job: A/C leak test and recharge; repair as needed
items.note: A recharge is the low end; a compressor is the high end.

items.t: Rear brakes wear out early
items.job: Replace rear brake pads and rotors
items.note: Owners report about $900 average when rotors and calipers are needed.

items.t: Power sliding door works only some of the time
items.job: Adjust door, repair harness or update module

items.t: Boom or hum from the driveshaft
items.job: Replace or rebalance driveshaft per bulletin

items.t: Misfires from poorly pressed valve seats
items.job: Replace cylinder head
items.note: Covered by Ford program 20B21 for affected vans.

items.t: 10-speed automatic harsh or delayed shifts
items.job: Update transmission software and adaptive relearn (valve body if needed)
items.note: Software is the low end; valve body work is the high end.

items.t: Rearview camera image distorted or missing (recall)
items.job: Replace rearview camera
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Driveshaft can separate (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair driveshaft
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Front passenger seat belt may not hold a child seat (recall)
items.job: Replace front passenger seat belt retractor
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Defrost and climate controls can stop working (recall)
items.job: Update or replace HVAC control module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rearview camera image freezes or goes blank (recall)
items.job: Update camera/radio software
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fuel tank vent valve may leak (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair fuel tank vent valve
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear axle may run low on oil or use wrong bolts (recall)
items.job: Inspect axle, refill lubricant or replace axle and bolts
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Steering shaft bolt can come loose (recall)
items.job: Replace steering shaft bolt and repair power steering ground
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Engine crossmember may not be secured (recall)
items.job: Replace engine crossmember fasteners
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake pedal can disconnect (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair brake pedal-to-booster connection
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Body module freeze shuts off trailer and interior lights (recall)
items.job: Reprogram body control module
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear seat belt reminder may not work (recall)
items.job: Repair rear seat belt buckle sensor system
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: E-Transit rear halfshaft can pull out (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace rear halfshaft
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: E-Transit battery tray rails can crack and let water in (recall)
items.job: Inspect battery; add drain holes or replace battery
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: E-Transit battery busbar washers may be missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair battery busbar fasteners
items.note: Free at a Ford dealer under the recall. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.
